title: Recursive NAND function
statement: For each nonnegative integer $d$, define a Boolean function on sign vectors with $2^d$ coordinates as follows: at depth zero it returns the sole input sign, and at depth $d+1$ it applies the two-input NAND function to the values obtained by recursively applying the depth-$d$ function to the two input blocks of size $2^d$. Here NAND returns $+1$ when both inputs are $-1$, and $-1$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: Input is a sign vector with $2^d$ coordinates
